Plating buildup can push the finished size out of tolerance and cause assembly interference; the designer should add a note specifying whether the dimension is pre-plate or post-plate.","recommended_correction":"Add a note clarifying that the 20±0.02 dimension is measured after plating, or provide an adjusted pre-plate dimension that accounts for the I.Z.B.P. coating thickness."},{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D24","page":1,"quote":"⌀8   H7 THRU`"},{"kind":"title_block","ref":"surface_treatment","page":1,"quote":"I.Z.B.P.
